items.title: SHIELD REPEL (ROUND 2)
items.where: KNOX slams the light shield and throws the target back

takes.a: A huge riot shield bash: a heavy body-slam impact of steel on flesh with a deep bass thud and a rush of displaced air, physical and brutal, no electricity, no sci-fi, no voices.
takes.b: A deep air cannon blast: one massive low whoomp of pressure that punches the chest, followed by a short gust of wind and falling dust, no electricity, no voices.
takes.c: A cinematic trailer impact hit: an enormous sub-bass boom with a short reversed whoosh leading into it, clean and powerful, no melody, no voices.
takes.d: A heavy steel plate struck once by a sledgehammer inside a concrete hall, a huge resonant clang with a deep thump underneath and a short echo, no voices.

items.title: HUD ALERT (ROUND 2)
items.where: each time a warning banner appears at the top of the feed

takes.a: A soft low single interface tone, warm and muted, like a quiet notification on professional military software, very short, dry.
takes.b: Two quick soft muted ticks from a computer interface, subtle and low, barely there, dry.
takes.c: A short low sonar-like pulse, dark and round, one pulse with a quick fade, dry.
takes.d: A brief tense low synth stab, a single dark note that swells and cuts, ominous, dry, no melody.
